text.tspan: Current React workbench: list + lock + separate resources + live annotation writes + submit
1 · LOAD TASKS AND CLAIM THE SELECTED TASK
tasks + file_url; React selects remembered / requested / first
The UI owns and renews the task lock; complex atomic write paths also enforce it server-side.
3 · EDIT LOOP · ANNOTATIONS ARE WRITTEN BEFORE SUBMIT
release task lock · batch counters / transitions
Side API: GET /tasks/next can select and lock a scheduler candidate, but the current React workbench does not consume it.
Dashed async branch after commit: Mask QC only when enabled + on_review_submit + active mask.
